ANN (Multilayer Perceptron).key_strength: Very fast training, low latency inference
ANN (Multilayer Perceptron).key_limitation: Discards spatial pixel correlation, sensitive to slight shifts

CNN (Deep Convolutional Net).layers: Conv2D(32)x2 -> MaxPool -> Conv2D(64)x2 -> MaxPool -> Dense(128) -> Dense(10)
CNN (Deep Convolutional Net).key_strength: Preserves 2D garment geometry; translation invariant via max-pooling
CNN (Deep Convolutional Net).key_limitation: Higher compute requirement per epoch during backpropagation
